\code{wr_clk_i} & in & 1 & clock & Clock of the write domain.\\
\code{wr_rst_n_i} & in & 1 & \code{wr_clk_i} & Active-low reset of the write domain. The caller supplies it already synchronised to \code{wr_clk_i}. While it is low, \code{wr_ready_o} is low.\\
\code{wr_data_i} & in & \code{WIDTH} (32) & \code{wr_clk_i} & Entry to write. The FIFO stores it on a cycle with \code{wr_valid_i} and \code{wr_ready_o} both high.\\
\code{wr_valid_i} & in & 1 & \code{wr_clk_i} & The write side offers an entry.\\
\code{wr_ready_o} & out & 1 & \code{wr_clk_i} & The FIFO accepts an entry. It is low when the FIFO is full and while \code{wr_rst_n_i} is low.\\
\code{rd_clk_i} & in & 1 & clock & Clock of the read domain.\\
\code{rd_rst_n_i} & in & 1 & \code{rd_clk_i} & Active-low reset of the read domain. The caller supplies it already synchronised to \code{rd_clk_i}. While it is low, \code{rd_valid_o} is low.\\
\code{rd_data_o} & out & \code{WIDTH} (32) & \code{rd_clk_i} & Oldest entry. It is valid only while \code{rd_valid_o} is high. It comes from the storage array without an output register.\\
\code{rd_valid_o} & out & 1 & \code{rd_clk_i} & The FIFO holds an entry that the read side has not taken. It is low when the FIFO is empty and while \code{rd_rst_n_i} is low.\\
\code{rd_ready_i} & in & 1 & \code{rd_clk_i} & The read side takes the entry. The FIFO removes it on a cycle with \code{rd_valid_o} and \code{rd_ready_i} both high.\\
